Read the setup guide ↗
Does this website run my agents?

No. Each person runs the desktop host on their own computer. This public PWA is a download and connection launcher. A central multi-user relay is not implemented.

Can I use an existing session?

Native resume is supported where the CLI provides it. Live attachment is available for supported OpenCode servers. Arbitrary already-open terminal control is not implemented.

What’s still in development?

Physical phone access and native Windows execution need verification. Windows file access is disabled. Background push, signed automatic desktop updates and a stable managed relay remain unfinished. Temporary HTTPS addresses change after restart.

What do I need on my phone?

Use Safari on iPhone or a supported Android browser. Scan the pairing QR from your computer first. Then install that host’s web app for quick terminal access. Your computer must stay awake and online.
